rules: Each key judgement has its own evidence ref. A trailing bundle of quotes is not a field link.
One sentence may support several fields, and several sentences may support one field.
Locating a quote and deciding that the quote supports the field are different checks.
A not-reported judgement records the text range and field that were examined. It does not invent a quote proving absence.
A source sentence and an abstract sentence are the same sentence only when the string or offset relation is verified. An unknown or different version stays in that state.
A new abstract finding does not need a native KG edge.
